mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors become risk-averse, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3pp increase in UNRATE within 3 months, indicating labor market softening, leads to decreased consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances with rising UNRATE, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain acceleration, manufacturers' increased production capacity boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances with INDPRO above its 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of increasing HOUST and RSAFS, indicating strengthening housing and retail demand, amplifies positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in joint growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.5%, signaling accommodative monetary policy, combined with a CPIAUCSL increase above 2%, indicating controlled inflation, produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with controlled inflation
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances meeting the trigger, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low UNRATE (< 5%), a PAYEMS increase above its 3-month average, signaling labor market strength, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances meeting the trigger, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth above 3% in a quarter, indicating robust economic demand, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with GDPC1 growth above 3%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2.5-year rolling window.
